cases.question: hw many paid holidays do we get in a yr
cases.answer:
PROITBRIDGE observes 12 paid holidays per year: 8 fixed national and state holidays, plus 4 optional (floating) holidays that you choose from the declared optional list. Holidays falling on a weekly off are not compensated with an alternative day. 

Source: Handbook, page 20
